newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks steady in London, track Wall St.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks steady in London, track Wall St.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London were steady on Thursday, with banking shares and Hong Kong Telecom providing the main interest in an otherwise dull market, dealers said.

The Hang Seng London Reference Index was up 50 points after weaker-than-expected U.S. durable goods figures for August were released, helping Wall Street higher. But Hong Kong stocks pared gains as U.S. stocks then drifted back.
By 1451 GMT the HSLRI was up 22.70 points at 11,658.83, after closing up 32.60 points at 11,636.13 in Hong Kong.
"The market should continue steady until the weekend because of the strong bond market," one trader said.
